content.text:
Now when you clone a Mesh, Line or Points object that uses an array of materials, the clone gets its own copy of the array. The materials inside it are still shared, as the issue asks.

I changed the `copy()` method in `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`, which `clone()` uses. If the source's material is an array, it now copies it with `slice()`; a single material is shared exactly as before. I left `Sprite` alone because it only ever has one material.

I haven't run any tests or tried the change out.
